html:
An economist from the north of Ivory Coast, prime minister under Houphouet-Boigny from 1990 to 1993 and president since 2011.

He had worked at the International Monetary Fund. After Houphouet's death, rivals said his parents were from Upper Volta and that he could not run for president, the core of the ivoirite fight. He won the 2010 election and took office after the second civil war. Under him the economy grew fast again, and Abidjan was rebuilt. He won a disputed third term in 2020 after a new constitution, which critics said broke the limit of two terms.
sum: An economist from the north of Ivory Coast, prime minister under Houphouet-Boigny from 1990 to 1993 and president since 2011.
